gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text.$value: Earn exclusive benefits as a GoStar member.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_10.$value: Every transaction helps you collect more Stars.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_14.$value: Our new loyalty program where you can get special benefits from your everyday activity.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_18.$value: You can check all your benefits on Gojek app.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_25.$value: Check more vouchers in Gojek app

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_26.$value:
Thanks for being a loyal GoTo customer! You've been selected to try GoStar, our new loyalty program. 

Every time you use Gojek or GoPay, you may earn 2 types of Stars. Status Stars help you level up and unlock even more benefits. Reward Stars can be exchanged for cool benefits, like vouchers.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_28.$value: What is GoStar and how does it work?

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_29.$value: Use Reward Stars to redeem vouchers for GoCar, GoFood, and more in the Reward Catalogue. As you level up, you may get level-exclusive benefits like Priority Help, FREE Faster Search, and more.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_30.$value: There are 4 GoStar levels: Member, New Star, Rising Star, and Superstar (the highest level!). Status Stars earned from using Gojek or GoPay help you level up.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_31.$value: What are the different levels? How do I level up?

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_32.$value: What rewards and benefits do I get?

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_33.$value: Make sure you’re using Gojek app v5.45.1 to access GoStar.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_34.$value: Both Status Stars and Reward Stars follow a 3-month cycle (quarter). Status Stars earned in a quarter expire on the first day of the next quarter. Reward Stars are valid for up to 2 quarters (6 months) and expire at the end of the following quarter.

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_35.$value: When do Status Stars and Reward Stars expire?

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_36.$value: View all information in Gojek app

gopay_home_gostarentrypoint_text_9.$value: Get early access to special rewards from your everyday activity.

Note: Q: Initially I'm proposing "Use Coins" bcs it's the most straightforward & neutral copy we can go with. But after discussing it in payments copy review, it is suggested that we should consider going with "Use now" (to emphasize urgency) or "Use all" (to hint coins all-in usage mechanism). Which will be the better option? Update: Upon testing a couple of users, they agree that "Use now" will emphasize urgency. However, they came up with follow up question "Use what now?" On the other hand, "Use all" seems to be the most confusing alternative for users bcs they're not sure what we mean by all. Is it all expiring Coins? Is it all Coins balance they have? Or is it all payment methods? This confusion also shown by a regular Coins user. While for "Use Coins", they're response is that they can understand easily that whatever happens, their Coins will be used once they tapped on the CTA. They don't need to think about how much will it be used or does it refers to another pay method. Hence, I'd suggest we still go with "Use Coins".
